summary:
Cosmic Remnants is an interactive storytelling website that takes visitors on a journey through the stories of space exploration equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It introduces some of the machines that played an important role in exploring other worlds, including Apollo lunar equipment, the Sojourner rover, and the Spirit and Opportunity rovers.

Through images, mission timelines, scientific discoveries, and a fun interactive quiz, visitors can learn about these missions and the valuable contributions made by these machines. Even though their missions have ended, their discoveries continue to help us understand the Moon and Mars. Our aim is to bring these forgotten explorers back into the spotlight and preserve their stories using information and resources from NASA.
details:
Project Details – Cosmic Remnants

Cosmic Remnants is a website we developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project is based on the challenge “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.”

When we think about space exploration, we usually remember the astronauts, planets and successful missions. But we often forget about the machines that made these missions possible. Many of these machines completed their missions and were left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through our project, we wanted to bring their stories back to life.

Our website introduces some of these important explorers, including the Apollo Lunar Module, Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity rovers. Visitors can explore their mission stories through images and simple explanations. We have also included a timeline of important mission events, scientific discoveries related to the equipment and an interactive quiz to make learning more interesting.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. HTML was used to create the structure, CSS to design the website and make it responsive, and JavaScript to add interactive features such as the quiz. We hosted the website using GitHub Pages. NASA mission information and reference links were used to prepare the content.

What makes our project special is the way we present these machines. Instead of looking at them simply as abandoned equipment, we see them as explorers that played an important role in helping humans understand other worlds. Even though their missions have ended, their contributions remain valuable.

Through Cosmic Remnants, we hope to make space exploration history interesting and easy to understand, especially for students and people who are curious about space. We want visitors to realise that every space mission leaves behind a story worth remembering.

Use of AI: We used ChatGPT to help us understand concepts, plan parts of the project, write and debug code, improve the wording and prepare the presentation. Our team reviewed the content, tested the website and worked on bringing the final project together.
